title: Upgrades
description: feed/v1/upgrades.json. Explainers added to items that sit in closed chunks, keyed by paper id. Closed chunks never change, so the app merges each entry over the matching item: has_explainer becomes true and explainer and hero are set. An item in the open chunk is upgraded in the chunk itself and does not appear here.

explainer.description: Path from the content base, for example papers/<id>/.

explained_at.description: UTC time the explainer was published, RFC 3339.
